title: How Developers Configure LLM Inference: A Large-Scale Study of Real-World Practices
title_zh: 开发者如何配置LLM推理：一项关于真实世界实践的大规模研究

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software systems, making deployment and inference configuration a recurring software engineering task. Inference backends expose many options that affect model loading, generation, serving, and request processing. Yet little is known about which of these options developers explicitly configure in practice. In this paper, we present a large-scale empirical study of LLM inference configuration practices in open-source software using Hugging Face Transformers, virtual Large Language Model (vLLM) , and the OpenAI API. We analyze 5,398 5,398 GitHub repositories using at least one of these backends and identify 345,117 345,117 explicitly configured option occurrences. Our results show that developers use only a small part of the available configuration space regularly. Although 98.8 % 98.8\% of the documented backend-specific options appear at least once, 78.9 % 78.9\% are configured in at most 10 % 10\% of repositories using the corresponding backend. Configurations are also small, with a median of 2 2 options for Transformers and 4 4 for vLLM and OpenAI, but the combinations of options vary widely: 56.8 56.8 – 61.6 % 61.6\% of multi-option signatures appear in only one repository. We also observe recurring option values as well as substantial variation in how values are chosen. Finally, configuration practices differ across application contexts, with option-adoption differences reaching 30.7 30.7 percentage points. These findings characterize the configuration surface developers make explicit rather than the importance or optimality of individual options. They provide empirical evidence for prioritizing future studies of inference configuration and for improving backend documentation and configuration support.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被集成到软件系统中，使部署和推理配置成为一项经常出现的软件工程任务。 推理后端提供了许多选项，影响模型加载、生成、服务和请求处理。 然而，对于开发者在实践中显式配置了哪些选项，人们知之甚少。 在本文中，我们对开源软件中使用 Hugging Face Transformers、virtual Large Language Model（vLLM）和 OpenAI API 的 LLM 推理配置实践进行了一项大规模实证研究。 我们分析了 5,398 个使用这些后端中至少一个的 GitHub 仓库，并识别出 345,117 次显式配置的选项出现。 我们的结果表明，开发者只是定期使用可用配置空间中的一小部分。 尽管文档中记录的后端专属选项中有 98.8% 至少出现一次，但其中 78.9% 仅在使用相应后端的仓库中至多 10% 被配置。 配置规模也很小，Transformers 的中位数为 2 个选项，vLLM 和 OpenAI 为 4 个选项，但选项组合变化很大：56.8–61.6% 的多选项签名仅出现在一个仓库中。 我们还观察到反复出现的选项取值，以及取值方式上的显著差异。 最后，配置实践因应用场景而异，选项采用率的差异最高可达 30.7 个百分点。 这些发现刻画的是开发者显式表达的配置面，而非各个选项的重要性或最优性。 它们为优先开展未来关于推理配置的研究以及改进后端文档和配置支持提供了实证依据。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-series ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) , Qwen ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Mistral ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) are increasingly integrated into modern software systems across applications such as coding assistants, content generation, search, and healthcare ( Bharathi Mohan et al., 2024 ; Murtaza et al., 2025 ) . Integrating these models requires running LLM inference, during which a trained model processes an input prompt or context to generate an output, typically token by token. As inference becomes a recurring software engineering task, developers must make configuration choices that can directly affect latency, throughput, energy consumption, monetary cost, and output quality ( Jegham et al., 2025 ; Shekhar et al., 2024 ) . These choices are particularly important because inference accounts for over 90 % 90\% of overall LLM compute cycles ( Patel et al., 2024 ) . Developers must therefore carefully configure inference to balance application efficiency and behavior.

paragraphs.en: These choices are complicated by the large configuration spaces of modern inference backends. For example, Hugging Face Transformers ( Wolf et al., 2019 ) , virtual Large Language Model (vLLM) ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , Ollama ( Marcondes et al., 2025 ) , llama.cpp ( , 2026 ) , and the OpenAI API 1 1 1 https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/python expose dozens to hundreds of options spanning model loading, decoding, resource management, serving, and request processing ( Park et al., 2025 ) . Developers must decide which options to configure, which defaults to retain, which values to select, and which options to combine, while the available choices also differ across backends.

paragraphs.en: However, these studies tell us little about which parts of the configuration space developers actually use in real software. Options that strongly affect performance in controlled experiments may rarely be configured in practice, while commonly configured options or combinations may receive comparatively little attention. Despite the growing body of work on LLM inference, we therefore lack a systematic understanding of which options developers configure, which values they select, how they combine options, and how these practices vary across backends and application contexts. Without this evidence, it is difficult to assess how well inference research reflects developer practice and which parts of the configuration space deserve further investigation or better tooling support.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些研究几乎无法告诉我们，开发者在真实软件中实际使用的是配置空间的哪些部分。 在受控实验中显著影响性能的选项，在实践中可能很少被配置，而常见的配置选项或组合可能得到的关注相对较少。 因此，尽管关于大语言模型（LLM）推理的研究日益增多，我们仍然缺乏系统性的认识：开发者配置哪些选项、选择哪些值、如何组合这些选项，以及这些实践如何因后端和应用场景而异。 缺乏这些证据，就难以评估推理研究在多大程度上反映了开发者的实践，也难以判断配置空间的哪些部分值得进一步研究或获得更好的工具支持。

paragraphs.en: Recent LLM inference backends expose configuration choices spanning model loading, memory management, batching, parallelism, caching, quantization, and generation. These interfaces build on optimization techniques such as continuous batching ( Yu et al., 2022 ) , PagedAttention ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ; Dao, 2023 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) , prefix caching ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) , chunked prefill ( Agrawal et al., 2024 ) , prefill–decode separation ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) , and quantization ( Frantar et al., 2022 ) . Depending on the backend, these choices appear as API parameters, command-line arguments, configuration files, or environment variables. Consequently, inference optimization techniques create a large and evolving configuration space.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的 LLM 推理后端提供了涵盖模型加载、内存管理、批处理、并行、缓存、量化与生成等方面的配置选项。 这些接口建立在诸如连续批处理（Yu et al., 2022）、PagedAttention（Kwon et al., 2023）、FlashAttention（Dao et al., 2022；Dao, 2023；Ye et al., 2025）、前缀缓存（Zheng et al., 2024）、分块预填充（Agrawal et al., 2024）、预填充—解码分离（Zhong et al., 2024）以及量化（Frantar et al., 2022）等优化技术之上。 依据后端的不同，这些选项以 API 参数、命令行参数、配置文件或环境变量的形式出现。 因此，推理优化技术构成了一个庞大且不断演化的配置空间。

paragraphs.en: Experimental Studies of LLM Inference Configurations Prior work has extensively evaluated how inference choices affect performance, efficiency, and output quality. Infrastructure-level studies have examined GPU characteristics, power-management settings, model parallelism, batching, concurrency, placement, and cluster architecture ( Patel et al., 2024 ; Stojkovic et al., 2024 ; Stojkovic et al., 2025 ; Lazuka et al., 2024 ; Martinez, 2025 ) . Model and workload-level studies have investigated model size, quantization, serving frameworks, prompt and generation lengths, request distributions, and task characteristics ( Samsi et al., 2023 ; Luccioni et al., 2024 ; Maliakel et al., 2025 ; Wilkins et al., 2024 ; Husom et al., 2025 ; Delavande et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Zine et al., 2026a ) . Other studies have focused on decoding and generation parameters such as temperature, top-k, top-p, beam search, and speculative decoding ( Shi et al., ; Arias et al., 2025 ; Nik et al., 2025 ; Fernandez et al., 2025 ; Zine et al., 2026b ) . Overall, these studies show that inference behavior depends on interacting choices across models, workloads, hardware, and optimization objectives. However, they primarily evaluate configurations selected a priori by researchers or optimization systems. They therefore address which configuration choices affect inference outcomes, whereas we investigate which parts of the available configuration space developers explicitly configure in real-world application software.

paragraphs.en: Mining Configuration Practices in Software and Machine Learning Researchers have used repository mining and static analysis to study configuration in software systems from several perspectives. Nadi et al. extracted constraints among configuration options ( Nadi et al., 2014 ) , Sayagh et al. studied how configuration options and frameworks are engineered and maintained ( Sayagh et al., 2017 ; Sayagh et al., 2018 ) , and Bessghaier et al. showed that deployment and runtime configurations can span heterogeneous software artifacts ( Bessghaier et al., 2023 ) . Related work has mined machine-learning repositories to characterize development practices and architectures ( Gonzalez et al., 2020 ; Nahar et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 挖掘软件与机器学习研究者的配置实践。研究者们已使用仓库挖掘和静态分析，从多个角度研究软件系统中的配置。 Nadi 等人提取了配置选项之间的约束（Nadi et al., 2014），Sayagh 等人研究了配置选项和框架是如何被工程化与维护的（Sayagh et al., 2017；Sayagh et al., 2018），而 Bessghaier 等人则表明部署与运行时配置可能跨越异构的软件制品（Bessghaier et al., 2023）。 相关工作挖掘了机器学习仓库，以刻画开发实践与架构（Gonzalez et al., 2020；Nahar et al., 2025）。

While their work focuses on model hyperparameters and their realization in ML implementations, we study inference-time configuration in application software, including option adoption, configured values, multi-option signatures, differences among inference backends, and associations with application contexts.

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, prior work has not systematically mined a large corpus of application repositories to characterize how developers explicitly use the configuration interfaces exposed by LLM inference backends. We complement experimental inference studies by providing evidence about which options, values, and combinations occur in practice, and complement configuration-mining studies by focusing specifically on LLM inference configuration.

paragraphs.en: This study analyzes LLM inference configurations in real-world software projects to understand how developers configure LLM inference in practice and to provide insights for software developers, inference backend maintainers, and software engineering researchers studying open-source software. More broadly, our study is guided by the following research question: How is the large configuration space exposed by LLM inference backends actually used by software developers? We investigate this question along three complementary dimensions, reflected in the following research questions.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究分析了真实软件项目中的 LLM 推理配置，以了解开发者在实践中如何配置 LLM 推理，并为软件开发者、推理后端维护者以及研究开源软件的软件工程研究者提供参考见解。 更广泛地说，我们的研究由以下研究问题引导：LLM 推理后端暴露的庞大配置空间实际上被软件开发者如何使用？ 我们从三个互补的维度对这一问题展开调查，这些维度体现在以下研究问题中。

sents.en: We investigate this question along three complementary dimensions, reflected in the following research questions.
sents.zh: 我们从三个互补的维度对这一问题展开调查，这些维度体现在以下研究问题中。

paragraphs.en: We investigate this question through two complementary dimensions: which options developers explicitly configure and which values they assign.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两个互补的维度来研究这一问题：开发者显式配置了哪些选项，以及他们为这些选项赋予了哪些值。

paragraphs.en: Despite the broad configuration space exposed by modern inference backends, little is known about which options developers explicitly configure and whether these choices differ across backends.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管现代推理后端暴露出了广泛的配置空间，但关于开发者显式配置哪些选项、以及这些选择是否因后端而异，目前仍知之甚少。

paragraphs.en: Beyond identifying which options are explicitly configured, examining the values developers choose helps determine whether configuration practices converge around a small set of commonly used values or remain diverse.

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 summarizes the main steps of our mining and analysis pipeline. Starting from GitHub open-source repositories, we first identify candidate projects through API-based search and apply selection criteria to build our repository dataset. We then analyze each repository’s source code by parsing it, identifying inference interfaces, mapping them to their configuration options, and extracting the corresponding configurations and values. We transform the extracted configurations into structured data for the analyses used to answer our research questions. The pipeline includes a refinement loop in which we manually examine recurring unresolved values to improve backend-specific interface mappings and extraction rules. The following subsections describe these steps in more detail: we first define the inference backends and configuration options covered by the study, then explain how repositories are discovered and selected, how configurations are extracted from source code, and how we analyze the resulting data with respect to our research questions.

paragraphs.en: For our study, we focus on three widely used ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) LLM inference backends: Hugging Face Transformers library ( Wolf et al., 2019 ) , vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) , and OpenAI Python SDK ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . We select these backends because they capture complementary ways of performing LLM inference, respectively covering local model inference, high-throughput model serving, and API-based inference. Hugging Face Transformers is a widely adopted open-source library that provides pretrained and fine-tuned models for a broad range of machine learning tasks and supports both training and inference. It can automatically download model weights and configurations and load them for local inference. vLLM is an open-source LLM inference and serving engine designed for high-throughput and memory-efficient model execution. It can load models from the Hugging Face ecosystem and provides optimized capabilities for offline inference and online serving, making it a state-of-the-art solution for LLM inference and serving ( Su et al., 2025 ) . Finally, we include the OpenAI Python SDK to capture API-based inference practices that are common in application-level LLM software. Beyond accessing OpenAI-hosted models, the SDK can be configured to interact with other cloud-based or locally deployed providers that expose an OpenAI-compatible API, including serving engines such as vLLM .
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的研究中，我们聚焦于三种被广泛使用（Jiang et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2026）的大语言模型推理后端：Hugging Face Transformers 库（Wolf et al., 2019）、vLLM（Kwon et al., 2023）以及 OpenAI Python SDK（OpenAI, 2026）。 我们选择这些后端是因为它们涵盖了互补的大语言模型推理方式，分别覆盖本地模型推理、高吞吐量模型服务和基于 API 的推理。 Hugging Face Transformers 是一个被广泛采用的开源库，它为广泛的机器学习任务提供预训练和微调模型，并同时支持训练与推理。 它能够自动下载模型权重和配置并加载它们以进行本地推理。vLLM 是一个开源的大语言模型推理与服务引擎，专为高吞吐量和高内存效率的模型执行而设计。 它可以从 Hugging Face 生态系统中加载模型，并为离线推理和在线服务提供优化的能力，使其成为大语言模型推理与服务的最先进解决方案（Su et al., 2025）。 最后，我们纳入了 OpenAI Python SDK，以涵盖应用级大语言模型软件中常见的基于 API 的推理实践。 除了访问 OpenAI 托管的模型之外，该 SDK 还可以配置为与其他提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 的云端或本地部署服务商进行交互，包括 vLLM 等服务引擎。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes the main categories of configuration options covered by our study across Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM , and the OpenAI API. To construct this classification, we first relied on the categories provided by the Hugging Face Transformers documentation and on the taxonomy proposed by Park et al. ( Park et al., 2025 ) . Because these existing classifications cover only part of the broader configuration space considered in our study, we adapted and extended them to account for additional concerns exposed by the selected interfaces. We assigned each option to a category based on its documented primary purpose. The second author independently reviewed the resulting assignments, and we discussed potentially ambiguous cases until we reached agreement. The complete classification, including each option’s assigned category, provenance, and the rationale for each assignment, is provided in our replication package. The package also reports which backends expose at least one option from each category.

paragraphs.en: We collected repositories from GitHub using the GitHub Search API. We ran the final mining run in mid-September 2026, providing a snapshot of the GitHub ecosystem at that time. Based on the inference backends defined above, we designed backend-specific search queries for Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM , and OpenAI to identify candidate repositories. For Hugging Face Transformers, the queries include terms such as transformers , huggingface transformers , text generation , llm inference , and causal lm . For vLLM , they include terms related to inference serving, such as vllm , llm serving , openai-compatible , vllm server , and inference server . OpenAI includes both general terms, such as openai and openai api , and API-specific expressions, such as chat.completions and responses.create , from openai import OpenAI , client.chat.completions.create , and openai.ChatCompletion.create .

paragraphs.en: We selected candidate repositories according to several criteria. We considered only publicly accessible GitHub repositories to support reproducibility ( Kalliamvakou et al., 2014 ) . The analysis was restricted to Python repositories, thereby focusing on Python-based LLM inference ecosystems. We chose Python because all three studied inference backends provide Python interfaces and because Python is the predominant language in open-source AI and machine-learning software ( Gonzalez et al., 2020 ) . To retain actively maintained and relevant projects, we required recent development activity, defined as activity on or after January 1 1 , 2025 2025 . We also excluded archived and forked repositories and kept only repositories with at least 50 50 stars. Finally, we discarded repositories whose names contained terms such as tutorial , demo , or example , since these are more likely to correspond to pedagogical or demonstrative artifacts than to actual usage projects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据若干标准筛选了候选仓库。 我们仅考虑可公开访问的 GitHub 仓库，以支持可复现性 ( Kalliamvakou et al., 2014 ) 。 分析仅限于 Python 仓库，从而聚焦于基于 Python 的 LLM 推理生态系统。 我们选择 Python 是因为所研究的三个推理后端都提供 Python 接口，并且 Python 是开源人工智能和机器学习软件中的主导语言 ( Gonzalez et al., 2020 ) 。 为了保留活跃维护且相关的项目，我们要求有近期的开发活动，定义为 2025 年 1 月 1 日或之后的活动。 我们还排除了已归档和分叉的仓库，仅保留至少获得 50 颗星标的仓库。 最后，我们剔除了名称中包含 tutorial 、 demo 或 example 等术语的仓库，因为这些仓库更可能是教学或演示性质的作品，而非实际使用项目。

paragraphs.en: For each candidate repository, we retrieve its contents and inspect its Python source files. We retain files with a Python extension ( .py ) and exclude paths unlikely to contain application-level inference code, such as tests and documentation. Each retained source file is parsed into an Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) using Python’s standard ast library. Files that cannot be parsed are skipped and recorded as analysis errors. The resulting ASTs constitute the source representation used by the subsequent static analysis.

paragraphs.en: We analyze each parsed source file using a custom AST visitor that examines imports, assignments, function calls, and method calls. For each inference backend, we define the inference interfaces targeted by the analysis based on the scope established in Section 3.4 . These backend-specific definitions identify the inference calls and configuration objects the analyzer recognizes, along with their associated configuration options. During AST traversal, the analyzer determines whether encountered calls or configuration objects match one of these targeted interfaces. A repository is considered to use a given inference backend when it detects at least one targeted interface in its source code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个自定义的 AST 访问器来分析每个已解析的源文件，该访问器会检查导入、赋值、函数调用和方法调用。 对于每个推理后端，我们根据第 3.4 节确定的范围定义分析所针对的推理接口。 这些针对特定后端的定义标识了分析器所识别的推理调用和配置对象，以及它们相关的配置选项。 在遍历 AST 的过程中，分析器判断所遇到的调用或配置对象是否与这些目标接口之一相匹配。 当在其源代码中检测到至少一个目标接口时，该仓库即被视为使用了给定的推理后端。

paragraphs.en: When the analyzer detects a targeted inference interface, it examines the associated configuration to identify options explicitly specified by the developer and tries to resolve their values.
paragraphs.zh: 当分析器检测到目标推理接口时，它会检查相关配置，以识别开发者显式指定的选项，并尝试解析它们的值。

paragraphs.en: An option is considered explicitly configured only when its name is explicitly specified in the repository together with a value expression and can be linked to a targeted inference interface. Backend defaults and unnamed positional arguments are therefore not counted. However, when a developer explicitly specifies a value equal to the backend default, the option is still considered explicitly configured. The extraction includes, for example, direct keyword arguments such as temperature=0.7 , configuration fields such as config.temperature = 0.7 , and dictionary entries such as {"temperature": 0.7} . Options may also originate from command-line arguments or external configuration files when they can be statically linked to the targeted inference interface.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当某个选项的名称在代码仓库中被显式指定并带有取值表达式，且能够关联到目标推理接口时，该选项才被视为显式配置。 因此，后端默认值和未命名的位置参数不计入在内。 但是，当开发者显式指定的取值等于后端默认值时，该选项仍被视为显式配置。 提取的内容包括例如直接的关键字参数（如 temperature=0.7）、配置字段（如 config.temperature = 0.7），以及字典条目（如 {"temperature": 0.7}）。 当选项能够被静态关联到目标推理接口时，选项也可能来源于命令行参数或外部配置文件。

paragraphs.en: For each extracted option, the analyzer attempts to resolve its value using several static-resolution strategies. These include following values propagated through variables, dictionaries, configuration objects, command-line parsers, and external configuration files. When a command-line argument is used without being overridden in the repository, its statically defined default value is retained. When an option can take multiple statically observable values, for example across conditional branches, we retain all observed alternatives. For each extracted option, the analyzer records the corresponding inference backend, repository, file location, targeted inference interface, option name, resolved value when available, and the static-resolution strategy used.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个提取到的选项，分析器会尝试使用多种静态解析策略来解析其值。 这些策略包括追踪通过变量、字典、配置对象、命令行解析器以及外部配置文件传播的值。 当某个命令行参数未被仓库中的内容覆盖时，将保留其静态定义的默认值。 当某个选项可能具有多个静态可观察的值时（例如跨越不同条件分支），我们会保留所有观察到的备选值。 对于每个提取到的选项，分析器会记录相应的推理后端、仓库、文件位置、目标推理接口、选项名称、解析得到的值（如果可用）以及所使用的静态解析策略。

paragraphs.en: Not all explicitly configured values can be resolved through static analysis. Some depend on runtime inputs, environment variables, user-provided command-line arguments, dynamically constructed objects, external files that cannot be linked to the inference interface, or project-specific wrappers that cannot be resolved with sufficient confidence. In such cases, the option is retained, and its value is recorded as unresolved rather than discarding the observation. The resulting resolved and unresolved observations constitute the extracted configuration dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 并非所有显式配置的值都能通过静态分析得到解析。 有些值依赖于运行时输入、环境变量、用户提供的命令行参数、动态构造的对象、无法与推断接口关联的外部文件，或无法以足够置信度解析的项目特定包装器。 在这种情况下，该选项会被保留，其值被记录为未解析，而不是丢弃该观测结果。 由此得到的已解析和未解析观测结果构成了提取出的配置数据集。

paragraphs.en: The extraction process includes an iterative refinement loop. After an initial analysis pass, we inspect extraction errors, unresolved values, and recurring missed patterns to identify the analyzer’s limitations. When a recurring pattern can be handled statically, we update the analyzer and re-analyze only the previously unresolved cases. This lets us iteratively improve value resolution without repeatedly processing the full dataset. Option values that still cannot be resolved after the run are kept as unresolved . After the final refinement, we re-ran the full process from the beginning to ensure no regressions and to produce the final dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 提取过程包括一个迭代式细化循环。 在初始分析阶段之后，我们检查提取错误、未解析的值以及反复出现的遗漏模式，以识别分析器的局限性。 当某个反复出现的模式可以静态处理时，我们会更新分析器，并仅对之前未解析的案例重新进行分析。 这使我们能够迭代式地改进值解析，而无需重复处理完整数据集。 在运行后仍无法解析的选项值将被保留为未解析状态。 在最终细化之后，我们从头重新运行了整个流程，以确保没有回归问题，并生成最终数据集。

paragraphs.en: Given the scale of our study, exhaustive manual validation is impractical. We therefore use three complementary samples for each inference backend: 60 60 detected configuration instances per backend ( 180 180 configurations in total), 30 30 rejected repository candidates per backend ( 90 90 repositories in total), and 30 30 unresolved option occurrences per backend ( 90 90 occurrences in total). The 60 60 detected configurations are used to validate interface detection, option extraction, and resolved values. We choose this sample size to provide roughly a 95 % 95\% chance of observing at least one error if the error rate were 5 % 5\% . The rejected candidates are used to check for missed interfaces, while the unresolved occurrences are used to understand why some values cannot be resolved.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于本研究规模庞大，进行穷尽式的人工验证并不现实。 因此，我们为每个推理后端使用三个互补的样本：每个后端 60 个检测到的配置实例（总计 180 个配置）、每个后端 30 个被拒绝的仓库候选（总计 90 个仓库），以及每个后端 30 个未解决的选项出现（总计 90 个出现）。 这 60 个检测到的配置用于验证接口检测、选项提取和已解析的值。 我们选择这一样本规模，是为了在错误率为 5% 的情况下，提供大约 95% 的机会至少观察到一次错误。 被拒绝的候选用于检查是否遗漏了接口，而未解决的出现则用于理解为什么某些值无法被解析。

paragraphs.en: For the 180 180 detected configurations, interface-detection precision is 91.7 % 91.7\% for Transformers, 100 % 100\% for vLLM , and 98.3 % 98.3\% for OpenAI, corresponding to 96.7 % 96.7\% across the validation sample. The five Transformers false positives come from generate calls that were associated with Transformers although the receiver belonged to another backend or library. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows a common configuration core across the three inference backends. paragraphs.en: Distribution of usage contexts. Table 4 shows that inference configurations occur across all ten usage contexts, although their distribution is uneven. Agents and tool use is the most frequent context, associated with 49.4 % 49.4\% of mapped repositories, followed by multimodal and vision ( 24.5 % 24.5\% ) and retrieval and knowledge systems ( 19.8 % 19.8\% ). paragraphs.en: Backend Roles The differences in configuration structure observed across backends appear closely related to their respective roles and abstraction levels. Transformers exposes decisions related to model loading, local execution, and generation, whereas vLLM additionally exposes serving concerns such as parallelism, memory utilization, batching, and execution. OpenAI, in contrast, abstracts most deployment-level decisions and primarily exposes request-level controls, including generation, output formatting, tool use, and streaming. These differences may partly explain the configuration-size differences observed in RQ2. Transformer configurations are typically smaller, with a median of 2 2 options compared with 4 4 for both vLLM and OpenAI. For vLLM , this larger configuration size can involve additional serving dimensions such as tensor parallelism, GPU memory utilization, or batching, while OpenAI reaches a similar median through different request-level controls.

paragraphs.en: Application Context Influence Application context measurably but selectively influences the inference options developers configure. Only a subset of options shows substantial and statistically significant differences across contexts. Some of these differences directly match the corresponding application needs, such as tool-related options in agent applications, streaming options in conversational and serving repositories, or multimodal-specific options in multimodal applications. For many other options, however, configuration practices remain relatively similar across contexts. One explanation is that many inference decisions are generic enough to be reused across application contexts. Another is that configuration choices may be driven more strongly by factors such as workload scale, hardware constraints, model characteristics, or deployment environment than by application context itself. The limited differences observed across contexts may also reflect limited context-specific adaptation: developers may reuse similar options even when different application contexts could benefit from different choices, particularly because it remains unclear whether the same options and values have comparable effects on metrics such as latency, energy consumption, or output quality across contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 应用上下文的影响 应用上下文对开发者所配置的推理选项有可测量但具有选择性的影响。 只有一部分选项在不同上下文之间表现出显著且具有统计显著性的差异。 其中一些差异直接对应相应的应用需求，例如智能体应用中与工具相关的选项、对话型和服务型仓库中的流式选项，以及多模态应用中的多模态专属选项。 然而，对于许多其他选项而言，配置实践在不同上下文之间保持相对相似。 一种解释是，许多推理决策具有足够的通用性，可以在不同应用上下文之间复用。 另一种解释是，配置选择可能更多地受工作负载规模、硬件限制、模型特性或部署环境等因素的驱动，而非应用上下文本身。 各上下文之间观察到的有限差异也可能反映了针对上下文的适配有限：即使不同的应用上下文本可以从不同的选择中获益，开发者也可能复用相似的选项，尤其是因为目前尚不清楚相同的选项和取值在不同上下文中对延迟、能耗或输出质量等指标是否具有可比的影响。

sents.en: Application Context Influence Application context measurably but selectively influences the inference options developers configure.
sents.zh: 应用上下文的影响 应用上下文对开发者所配置的推理选项有可测量但具有选择性的影响。

sents.en: Only a subset of options shows substantial and statistically significant differences across contexts.
sents.zh: 只有一部分选项在不同上下文之间表现出显著且具有统计显著性的差异。

sents.en: Some of these differences directly match the corresponding application needs, such as tool-related options in agent applications, streaming options in conversational and serving repositories, or multimodal-specific options in multimodal applications.

sents.en: For many other options, however, configuration practices remain relatively similar across contexts.
sents.zh: 然而，对于许多其他选项而言，配置实践在不同上下文之间保持相对相似。

sents.en: One explanation is that many inference decisions are generic enough to be reused across application contexts.

paragraphs.en: Implications for Practice and Research Our findings have implications for developers, inference backend maintainers, and researchers.
paragraphs.zh: 实践与研究启示 我们的研究结果对开发者、推理后端维护者以及研究人员具有重要意义。

paragraphs.en: For developers, the configurations observed in real-world repositories provide descriptive reference points for understanding which parts of the inference configuration space other projects make explicit. However, they should not be interpreted as recommended or optimal configurations. Common practices may reflect conventions, available examples, or existing guidance rather than deliberate optimization. They are therefore better viewed as examples of configurations used in practice, which developers can adapt to their own workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 对于开发者而言，在真实仓库中观察到的配置提供了描述性的参考点，有助于理解其他项目对推理配置空间中的哪些部分进行了显式设置。 然而，这些配置不应被解读为推荐或最优的配置。 常见做法可能反映的是惯例、可用的示例或已有的指导，而非经过深思熟虑的优化。 因此，它们更适合被视为实践中所使用配置的示例，开发者可以根据自己的工作负载进行调整。

paragraphs.en: For inference backend maintainers, our results show which parts of the configuration space developers commonly use and which remain less visible in practice. This could help developers understand not only what an option does, but also when it is worth configuring.
paragraphs.zh: 对于推理后端维护者而言，我们的结果显示了开发者常用的配置空间部分以及在实践中关注度较低的部分。 除了记录单个选项之外，指导文档还可以更清晰地将相关选项组与具体目标和使用条件联系起来。 例如，文档可以指出哪些选项与吞吐量、内存占用、长上下文推理、输出控制或特定应用场景特别相关。 这可以帮助开发者不仅了解某个选项的作用，还能明白何时值得对其进行配置。

paragraphs.en: For researchers, our results can help make the large inference configuration space more tractable to study. Exhaustively evaluating all options, values, combinations, models, and application contexts is impractical. The options and combinations observed in practice can therefore help prioritize which parts of this space are most relevant to investigate. At the same time, rarely configured options should not be overlooked, as their limited adoption may reflect limited awareness rather than usefulness. More broadly, the patterns observed in our study highlight the importance of understanding not only the effects of configuration choices, but also the factors that drive how developers make these choices.

paragraphs.en: LLM inference configuration is becoming an increasingly important aspect of deploying LLM -based software, with growing research interest in understanding how configuration choices affect performance, energy consumption, and accuracy. In this paper, we complement these studies with a large-scale empirical analysis of the inference options developers explicitly configure in open-source LLM inference software.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 推理配置正日益成为部署基于 LLM 的软件的一个重要方面，学界对理解配置选择如何影响性能、能耗和准确性的研究兴趣也在不断增长。 在本文中，我们对开发者在开源 LLM 推理软件中显式配置的推理选项进行了大规模实证分析，以补充这些研究。

sents.en: LLM inference configuration is becoming an increasingly important aspect of deploying LLM -based software, with growing research interest in understanding how configuration choices affect performance, energy consumption, and accuracy.
sents.zh: LLM 推理配置正日益成为部署基于 LLM 的软件的一个重要方面，学界对理解配置选择如何影响性能、能耗和准确性的研究兴趣也在不断增长。

sents.en: In this paper, we complement these studies with a large-scale empirical analysis of the inference options developers explicitly configure in open-source LLM inference software.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们对开发者在开源 LLM 推理软件中显式配置的推理选项进行了大规模实证分析，以补充这些研究。

paragraphs.en: Our results reveal a clear gap between the large configuration spaces exposed by inference backends and the much smaller set of options that developers use frequently. Across the studied repositories, nearly all documented options in scope appear at least once, yet approximately 80% are explicitly configured in at most 10% of repositories using the corresponding backend. Individual configurations are small relative to the available configuration spaces, while the combinations of options used across projects remain highly diverse and reflect the different abstractions each backend exposes. Our exploratory context analysis further identifies selected associations between application contexts and option adoption. These findings characterize configuration practice, not configuration effectiveness: frequently observed choices are not necessarily optimal, and rarely explicit options may remain important through backend defaults. Future work can connect these observed practices with controlled measurements of latency, throughput, energy consumption, monetary cost, and output quality to determine whether the options developers frequently manipulate are also the most consequential and whether rarely configured options represent overlooked optimization opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果揭示了推理后端暴露的庞大配置空间与开发者频繁使用的少量选项之间存在明显差距。 在所研究的仓库中，几乎所有在范围内的文档化选项都至少出现过一次，但约 80% 的选项在使用相应后端的仓库中最多只有 10% 明确配置了它们。 单个配置相对于可用的配置空间而言都很小，而各项目中使用的选项组合仍然高度多样，并反映了每个后端所暴露的不同抽象。 我们的探索性情境分析进一步识别出了应用情境与选项采用之间的若干关联。 这些发现刻画的是配置实践而非配置有效性：经常观察到的选择未必是最优的，而很少被显式设置的选项可能通过后端默认值仍然十分重要。 未来的工作可以将这些观察到的实践与对延迟、吞吐量、能耗、货币成本和输出质量的受控测量联系起来，以确定开发者经常调整的选项是否也是影响最大的选项，以及很少被配置的选项是否代表着被忽视的优化机会。
